# Asclepiu
A hospitable planet with a stable biosphere and a breathable atmosphere.
The surface of this planet is somewhat rich in Titanium, as well as having somewhat low concentrations of most conventional metals for it's size. Deeper geological surveys indicate the presence of rarer minerals in small quanities below the crust.
Most of the life on this planet consists of a type of grass that lives off of the highly nutrient dense slurry that concentrates around the shoreline. There is also a large amount of marine life inside of the oceans, most of which is bacteria that breaks down the bigger multicellular organisms into a concentrated nutrient slurry.
Early geological surveys shows an abnormally high concentration of nuclear material, as well as byproducts of large scale nuclear fission and Tritium fusion within the soil.
